Cardiovascular Disease

Ailment cardiovascular heart-disease circulation vascular

Evidence: peer_reviewed

Summary

Group of diseases affecting the heart and blood vessels, including coronary artery disease, heart failure, and stroke.

Symptoms

  • chest pain
  • shortness of breath
  • fatigue
  • palpitations
  • dizziness
  • swelling in legs/ankles

Remedies for This Condition

  • Cell Salts
    Biochemical tissue salts (Schuessler salts) that help regulate fluid balance and cellular function in the body.
  • Celery Seed
    Natural diuretic that helps reduce fluid retention and uric acid buildup, beneficial for edema and gout.
  • Heart Tonic (Hawthorn)
    Hawthorn berry and leaf extract that supports heart function and improves circulation, reducing edema related to cardiac insufficiency.
  • Hawthorn Berry
    Heart tonic herb that supports cardiovascular health by improving blood flow and strengthening heart contractions.
  • Coenzyme Q10

Affected Body Systems

  • cardiovascular
  • circulatory
  • renal

Severity Levels

  • stable
  • unstable
  • critical

Related Conditions

  • Arthritis
    Inflammatory joint disease; managed with dietary and herbal interventions.
  • Edema, Fluid Retention
    Excess fluid accumulation in tissues causing swelling, typically in legs, ankles, or abdomen. Can be caused by heart conditions, kidney dysfunction, liver disease, or medication side effects.
  • Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
    Infection anywhere in the urinary tract, most commonly in women. Characterized by burning pain during urination and frequent urges.
  • Migraine
    Recurrent severe headaches often with visual disturbances, nausea, and sensitivity to light and sound.
  • Hypertension
    Chronic elevation of blood pressure in the arteries, increasing risk of heart disease, stroke, and kidney failure.
  • Heart Failure
    Cardiovascular condition where the heart cannot pump enough blood to meet the body's needs, often causing fluid buildup and edema.
  • Asthma
    Chronic inflammatory disease of the airways that causes wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, and coughing.
  • Irritable Bowel Syndrome
    Functional gastrointestinal disorder characterized by abdominal pain, bloating, and altered bowel habits (diarrhea or constipation).
  • Insomnia & Sleep Disorders
    Sleep disorders characterized by difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or excessive daytime sleepiness, often related to stress and anxiety.
  • Eczema & Skin Disorders
    Chronic inflammatory skin conditions causing dry, itchy, inflamed skin; includes eczema, psoriasis, and dermatitis.
  • Blood Sugar Imbalance
    Imbalances in blood sugar regulation, including hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia.
  • Digestive Discomfort
    General digestive discomfort including bloating, gas, and indigestion.
  • Metabolic Syndrome
    Cluster of conditions including high blood pressure, high blood sugar, excess body fat around the waist, and abnormal cholesterol levels.
  • Acid Reflux / GERD
    Gastroesophageal reflux disease causing heartburn and acid regurgitation.
  • High Cholesterol
    Elevated cholesterol levels in the blood, increasing risk of cardiovascular disease.
  • High Blood Pressure
    Chronically elevated blood pressure requiring management.
  • Gout
    Form of inflammatory arthritis characterized by recurrent attacks of a red, tender, hot, and swollen joint.
  • Prostatitis
    Inflammation of the prostate gland, often causing pain and urinary symptoms.
